findings: The partitioned command path selects each first-level child that has no children, otherwise its grandchildren, preserving child order.
Each work root has an independent corner-key pool. Equal coordinates can have separate corner objects in different pools.
The triangle bounds overlap check is inclusive; admitted candidate centers outside a selected work root descend to its boundary leaves instead of being discarded.
The worker resets its triangle counter for each source/work-root invocation. Source-slot advance appends sample storage without an explicit last-triangle-ID reset in the inspected function.
A synthetic one-triangle-per-source control preserves the resulting counter collision in this static reference. This is not proof of a native application defect.
The implementation is sequential and models partition ownership/order; it does not execute or validate native parallel scheduling.
